grade: expected $1799.00 (Asus ROG Strix SCAR Edition GL503VM-ED115T)
answer:
The most expensive laptop is the **Asus ROG Strix SCAR Edition GL503VM-ED115T** at **$1799.00**. It is listed on page 5.

I checked all 20 pages, which hold 117 laptops. The next most expensive are two Asus ROG Strix GL702ZC models at $1769 each.

I read the pages 2–20 by fetching them from inside the open browser tab. The browser tab is still open, now on page 20, the last page.

tool_input.command: S=$(agent-browser session id --scope worktree --prefix task); echo $S; agent-browser --session $S open https://webscraper.io/test-sites/e-commerce/static/computers/laptops; agent-browser --session $S eval 'document.querySelectorAll(".pagination li").length + " " + [...document.querySelectorAll(".pagination a")].map(a=>a.textContent).join(",")'

for p in $(seq 1 20); do agent-browser --session task-d39348156920 open "https://webscraper.io/test-sites/e-commerce/static/computers/laptops?page=$p" >/dev/null 2>&1; agent-browser --session task-d39348156920 eval '[...document.querySelectorAll(".product-wrapper, .thumbnail")].map(t=>(t.querySelector(".price")?.textContent||"")+"|"+(t.querySelector(".title")?.title||t.querySelector(".title")?.textContent)).join("\n")' | tr -d '"' ; done | sed 's/\\n/\n/g' | sort -t'$' -k2 -n -r | head -5
